decisions.reason: As the agency-focused platform at the center of the firm's direction, it remains strategically important and the option value of continued investment is high relative to the likely cost of keeping it.

It still fits the core hosting business and is probably inexpensive to maintain on existing infrastructure, but after two years its weaker differentiation makes it the most plausible candidate for later rationalization.
Because this security and compliance extension is new, closely tied to the established offer, and likely cheap to continue while demand becomes clearer, it is worth keeping for another year.
